title: Login Issue - Can't Access Account
description: User is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still failing to access.

title: Payment Failed - Card Declined
description: User is trying to make a payment but is getting a 'Card Declined' error. They've confirmed their card has sufficient balance.

title: Unable to Download Invoice
description: Customer cannot download their invoice from the billing history page. The button seems to be unresponsive.

title: Incorrect Billing Address
description: Customer's billing address shows a different city. They updated it, but the invoice still shows the old one.

title: App Crash on Launch
description: Customer reports that the mobile app crashes immediately upon opening on Android 13.

title: Refund Not Processed
description: Customer requested a refund two weeks ago but has not received the amount yet. They have the transaction ID.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Issue
description: Customer is not receiving 2FA codes on their registered phone number. They have tried restarting their phone.

title: Unable to Update Profile Picture
description: Customer tried to upload a new profile picture (JPG, <1MB), but it fails without an error message.

title: Subscription Auto-Renewal
description: Customer wants to disable auto-renewal for their subscription but the toggle is disabled in their account settings.

title: Missing Order Confirmation Email
description: Customer placed an order but didn't receive a confirmation email even though the payment was successful.

title: Feature Request: Dark Mode
description: A long-time user is requesting a dark mode theme for the application to reduce eye strain during night-time use.

title: API Rate Limit Exceeded
description: A developer using our API is consistently hitting the rate limit, although their usage seems to be within the documented limits.
